elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause: "MSL shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than U.S. $1,000,000 per occurrence".

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Same sentence: "and U.S. $2,000,000 in the aggregate".

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: "professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than U.S. $2,000,000".

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: "where MSL processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for IBM, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than U.S. $5,000,000" — trigger covers every category of Customer data rather than selected named types.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: "and workers' compensation insurance as required by law".

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: "MSL shall provide certificates of insurance to IBM on request."

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: E&O of not less than U.S. $2,000,000 exceeds the USD 1M fallback floor.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Cyber and privacy liability of not less than U.S. $5,000,000 exceeds the USD 2M fallback floor.

reasons: All six preferred elements appear in a single inserted insurance paragraph with the exact limits, bases (per occurrence / aggregate), the conditional cyber trigger, workers' compensation and certificates on request; the preferred level is complete.
The fallback floors are independently satisfied by the same inserted limits.

Minimality: the insertion is a concise new clause for a genuinely missing obligation. The drafter omitted the model language's optional extras ("at its own expense" and the one-year survival tail), which would have been non-minimal; no wording outside the checklist was added and no existing text was deleted or paraphrased.

Intent preserved: the asset-specific insurance provisions (§13.1(b) consigned-Product replacement-value cover with IBM as joint insured, §21.2 IBM-owned tooling) remain intact and do not contradict the new general coverage requirement; no undefined terms or dangling cross-references are introduced.
Minor note only (not a defect): the clause does not state a duration/term anchor for the coverage, but no selected element requires one.
